# J. L. Austin

*1911 – 1960 · British · [Ordinary language philosophy](../movements/ordinary-language-philosophy.md)*

British philosopher, the presiding figure of Oxford philosophy: through close examination of the distinctions of ordinary language, he discovered performative utterances and founded speech act theory (How to Do Things with Words).
